svg.title: CRESCENT: Competing-Risk Event-Sequence network for Condition-specific Estimation of Newly recorded diagnoses over Time
svg.desc: Animated header spelling out the CRESCENT acronym, followed by a schematic showing static covariates and pre-index clinical events entering the Crescent encoder with a 3-layer Transformer, condition-specific cross-attention and additive log-hazards, a parallel death head, and 10-year competing-risks cumulative incidence trajectories.

g.text: CLS summary to the death head
